CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.streamlink_wire_set_enabled(p_enabled boolean)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF p_enabled IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'wire-switch-null';
  END IF;
  UPDATE private.streamlink_wire_switch
     SET enabled = p_enabled,
         updated_at = now()
   WHERE id = 1;
  RETURN p_enabled;
END
$function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.streamlink_specimen_digest(p_mon jsonb)
 RETURNS bytea
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
  SELECT private.streamlink_sha256(
    jsonb_build_object(
      'contentBuild', p_mon->>'contentBuild',
      'formId', private.streamlink_json_int(p_mon->'formId'),
      'dex', private.streamlink_json_int(p_mon->'dex'),
      'level', private.streamlink_json_int(p_mon->'level'),
      'natureId', private.streamlink_json_int(p_mon->'natureId'),
      'abilityId', private.streamlink_json_int(p_mon->'abilityId'),
      'abilitySlot', p_mon->>'abilitySlot',
      'ivs', jsonb_build_object(
        'hp', private.streamlink_json_int(p_mon#>'{ivs,hp}'),
        'atk', private.streamlink_json_int(p_mon#>'{ivs,atk}'),
        'def', private.streamlink_json_int(p_mon#>'{ivs,def}'),
        'spa', private.streamlink_json_int(p_mon#>'{ivs,spa}'),
        'spd', private.streamlink_json_int(p_mon#>'{ivs,spd}'),
        'spe', private.streamlink_json_int(p_mon#>'{ivs,spe}')
      ),
      'evs', jsonb_build_object(
        'hp', private.streamlink_json_int(p_mon#>'{evs,hp}'),
        'atk', private.streamlink_json_int(p_mon#>'{evs,atk}'),
        'def', private.streamlink_json_int(p_mon#>'{evs,def}'),
        'spa', private.streamlink_json_int(p_mon#>'{evs,spa}'),
        'spd', private.streamlink_json_int(p_mon#>'{evs,spd}'),
        'spe', private.streamlink_json_int(p_mon#>'{evs,spe}')
      ),
      'moves', (
        SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(
          jsonb_build_object(
            'moveId', private.streamlink_json_int(s->'moveId'),
            'method', s->>'method',
            'versionGroup', s->>'versionGroup'
          ) ORDER BY private.streamlink_json_int(s->'moveId')
        ), '[]'::jsonb)
        FROM jsonb_array_elements(
          CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(p_mon->'moveSlots') = 'array' THEN p_mon->'moveSlots' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END
        ) s
      ),
      'gender', p_mon->>'gender',
      'shiny', CASE WHEN p_mon->'shiny' = 'true'::jsonb THEN true ELSE false END,
      'friendship', private.streamlink_json_int(p_mon->'friendship')
    )::text
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.streamlink_gender(p_gender_rate integer, p_roll bigint)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN p_gender_rate = -1 THEN 'Genderless'
    WHEN p_gender_rate = 0 THEN 'Male'
    WHEN p_gender_rate = 8 THEN 'Female'
    WHEN (p_roll % 8) < p_gender_rate THEN 'Female'
    ELSE 'Male'
  END;
$function$

functions.name: streamlink_level_up_slice
functions.identity: p_content_build text, p_form_id integer, p_level integer
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.streamlink_level_up_slice(p_content_build text, p_form_id integer, p_level integer)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
  WITH form AS (
    SELECT learnset_version_group AS vg, learnset_status
    FROM private.ref_forms WHERE content_build = p_content_build AND form_id = p_form_id
  ),
  ranked AS (
    SELECT l.move_id, l.level, l.sort_order, m.slug, m.pp, f.vg,
           row_number() OVER (ORDER BY l.level, l.sort_order, l.move_id) AS rn,
           count(*) OVER () AS n
    FROM form f
    JOIN private.ref_learnsets l ON l.content_build = p_content_build AND l.form_id = p_form_id
     AND l.version_group = f.vg AND l.method = 'level-up' AND l.level <= p_level
    JOIN private.ref_moves m ON m.content_build = p_content_build AND m.move_id = l.move_id
    WHERE f.learnset_status = 'resolved' AND f.vg IS NOT NULL
  ),
  last4 AS (SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE rn > n - 4)
  SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'moveId', move_id, 'pp', pp, 'ppMax', pp, 'method', 'level-up', 'versionGroup', vg, 'name', slug
  ) ORDER BY level, sort_order, move_id), '[]'::jsonb)
  FROM last4;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.encounter_pokemon_level(p_dex integer, p_round_id uuid)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$
  select case
    when p_dex is null or p_round_id is null then null
    else bounds[1] + (
      abs(('x' || substr(md5(p_round_id::text), 1, 8))::bit(32)::int)
      % (greatest(bounds[2] - bounds[1], 0) + 1)
    )
  end
  from (select private.lgpe_level_bounds(p_dex) as bounds) s;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.streamlink_wire_is_enabled()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_on boolean;
BEGIN
  -- Intentionally ignore current_setting('starlight.wire_genval') and every
  -- other GUC / client flag. Only the named switch table can enable WIRE.
  SELECT s.enabled INTO v_on
  FROM private.streamlink_wire_switch s
  WHERE s.id = 1;
  RETURN coalesce(v_on, false);
END
$function$

functions.name: streamlink_protected_trainer
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.streamlink_protected_trainer(p_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF p_user_id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN false;
  END IF;
  IF to_regclass('public.profiles') IS NULL THEN
    RETURN false;
  END IF;
  RETURN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.profiles p
    WHERE p.id = p_user_id
      AND (
        lower(coalesce(p.twitch_login, '')) IN ('sorastarlight', 'twinklephoenixstar')
        OR lower(coalesce(p.username, '')) IN ('sorastarlight', 'twinklephoenixstar')
      )
  );
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.lgpe_habitat(p_dex integer)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$
  select case
    when p_dex between 1 and 9 then 'Pallet Town'
    when p_dex in (10,11,12,13,14,15,25,26) then 'Viridian Forest'
    when p_dex in (16,17,18,19,20) then 'Route 1'
    when p_dex in (21,22,39,40) then 'Route 3'
    when p_dex in (23,24,27,28) then 'Route 4'
    when p_dex in (29,30,31,32,33,34,56,57) then 'Route 22'
    when p_dex in (35,36,41,42,46,47,74,75,76) then 'Mt. Moon'
    when p_dex in (37,38,58,59) then 'Route 7'
    when p_dex in (43,44,45,69,70,71,48,49) then 'Route 2'
    when p_dex in (50,51) then 'Diglett''s Cave'
    when p_dex in (52,53) then 'Route 8'
    when p_dex in (54,55,60,61,62,118,119,129,130) then 'Route 6'
    when p_dex in (63,64,65,96,97) then 'Route 11'
    when p_dex in (66,67,68,104,105,115) then 'Rock Tunnel'
    when p_dex in (72,73,90,91,98,99,116,117,120,121) then 'Route 19'
    when p_dex in (77,78,133,134) then 'Route 17'
    when p_dex in (79,80,86,87,131,144) then 'Seafoam Islands'
    when p_dex in (81,82,100,101,125,135,145) then 'Power Plant'
    when p_dex in (83,84,85,123,143) then 'Route 12'
    when p_dex in (88,89,109,110) then 'Pokémon Mansion'
    when p_dex in (92,93,94) then 'Pokémon Tower'
    when p_dex in (95,111,112,126,136,146) then 'Victory Road'
    when p_dex in (102,103,147,148,149) then 'Safari Zone'
    when p_dex in (106,107) then 'Saffron City'
    when p_dex in (108,114,127,128) then 'Route 18'
    when p_dex in (113,124) then 'Route 10'
    when p_dex = 122 then 'Route 2'
    when p_dex = 132 then 'Route 13'
    when p_dex = 137 then 'Silph Co.'
    when p_dex in (138,139,140,141,142) then 'Cinnabar Lab'
    when p_dex = 150 then 'Cerulean Cave'
    when p_dex = 151 then 'Faraway place'
    else 'Kanto'
  end;
$function$

functions.name: capture_base_chance
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.capture_base_chance(p_catch_rate integer, p_config jsonb DEFAULT NULL::jsonb)
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  select coalesce(
    (
      select (t->>'chance')::numeric
      from jsonb_array_elements(
        coalesce(
          nullif(coalesce(p_config, private.capture_config())->'baseChanceTiers', 'null'::jsonb),
          '[]'::jsonb
        )
      ) t
      where coalesce(p_catch_rate, 45) >= (t->>'minCatchRate')::int
      order by (t->>'minCatchRate')::int desc
      limit 1
    ),
    0.16
  );
$function$

functions.name: capture_honey_modifier
functions.identity: p_contributors integer, p_participants integer, p_config jsonb
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.capture_honey_modifier(p_contributors integer, p_participants integer, p_config jsonb DEFAULT NULL::jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  with cfg as (select coalesce(p_config, private.capture_config()) as c),
  rate as (
    select least(1.0,
      greatest(0, coalesce(p_contributors, 0))::numeric / greatest(coalesce(p_participants, 0), 1)::numeric
    ) as r
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'contributors', greatest(0, coalesce(p_contributors, 0)),
    'participants', greatest(0, coalesce(p_participants, 0)),
    'rate', rate.r,
    'multiplier', coalesce((
      select (t->>'multiplier')::numeric
      from cfg, jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(nullif(cfg.c->'honeyTiers', 'null'::jsonb), '[]'::jsonb)) t
      where rate.r >= (t->>'minRate')::numeric
      order by (t->>'minRate')::numeric desc
      limit 1
    ), 1.0)
  )
  from rate;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.streamlink_secure_u32()
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE sql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
  SELECT (
    ('x' || substr(replace(gen_random_uuid()::text, '-', ''), 1, 8))::bit(32)::bigint
  ) & 4294967295;

functions.name: streamlink_next_public_id
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.streamlink_next_public_id(p_prefix text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  prefix text := upper(coalesce(nullif(btrim(p_prefix), ''), 'SL'));
BEGIN
  IF prefix NOT IN ('SL', 'LG') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'bad-public-id-prefix';
  END IF;
  RETURN prefix || lpad(nextval('public.catch_serial')::text, 8, '0');
END
$function$

  from (

      'masterball',
      'premierball','luxuryball','healball','friendball','loveball','nestball','netball',
      'repeatball','timerball','diveball','duskball','quickball','fastball','lureball',
      'moonball','heavyball','levelball','safariball','sportball','cherishball',

      'featherball','wingball','jetball','leadenball','gigatonball','originball','strangeball'
    ]) as k
    union
    select jsonb_object_keys(coalesce(grants, '{}'::jsonb))
    from private.store_items

functions.name: store_item_json
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.store_item_json(i private.store_items)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  select jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
    'sku', i.sku, 'name', i.name, 'blurb', i.blurb, 'detail', nullif(i.extra->>'detail', ''),
    'cost', i.cost, 'bits', nullif(i.bits, 0), 'grants', i.grants,
    'sprite', nullif(i.sprite, ''), 'thumb', nullif(i.thumb, ''), 'featured', i.featured,
    'status', coalesce(nullif(i.status, ''), coalesce(nullif(i.extra->>'status', ''), 'published')),
    'productKind', coalesce(nullif(i.extra->>'productKind', ''),
      case when nullif(i.extra->>'pack', '') is not null then 'avatar' when i.bits > 0 then 'bits'
        when (select count(*) from jsonb_object_keys(coalesce(i.grants, '{}'::jsonb))) > 1 then 'pack' else 'item' end),
    'pack', nullif(i.extra->>'pack', ''), 'looks', i.extra->'looks', 'bitsTitles', i.extra->'bitsTitles',
    'ballKey', nullif(i.extra->>'ballKey', ''),
    'qty', coalesce(nullif((i.grants->>coalesce(nullif(i.extra->>'ballKey', ''), '') )::int, 0), 1),
    'identity', private.item_identity(coalesce(nullif(i.extra->>'ballKey', ''), (select k from jsonb_object_keys(coalesce(i.grants,'{}'::jsonb)) k limit 1)))
  ));
$function$

functions.name: item_power_label
functions.identity: p_mult numeric, p_guaranteed boolean, p_collector boolean
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.item_power_label(p_mult numeric, p_guaranteed boolean, p_collector boolean)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$
  select case
    when coalesce(p_guaranteed, false) then 'ALWAYS CATCHES'
    when coalesce(p_collector, false) then 'COLLECTOR'
    when coalesce(p_mult, 1) >= 1.45 then 'VERY STRONG'
    when coalesce(p_mult, 1) >= 1.3 then 'STRONG'
    when coalesce(p_mult, 1) >= 1.15 then 'RELIABLE'
    when coalesce(p_mult, 1) > 1.0 then 'MODEST'
    else 'STANDARD'
  end;
$function$
